# MegaFon

English · [Русский](../ru/companies/megafon.md) · [AI Interview Atlas](../../README.md) › [Companies](../README.md#companies)

Russian Big Tech · Russia · Loop reviewed 2026-09-29

In 2024 MegaFon's data science team published preparation material for each section of its data scientist interview. The specialised section's reading covers language models, instruction tuning and RLHF; the material lists topics to prepare, not questions asked.

On this page: [Interview loop](#loop) · [Official preparation material](#prep) · [Questions (0)](#questions)

- **AI Engineering:** ML engineer / data scientist
